title: Live: Ukrainian negotiator to meet US team ahead of fresh Russia talks, Zelensky says
summary: ⁠Ukraine's lead negotiator Rustem Umerov will meet with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on Thursday, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Wednesday, ahead of a fresh round of trilateral talks with Russia expected in March. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
